text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! I heard you're good at drawing!
You shall paint Demon Lord Windy-chan and her minions!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"It's a suuuuper villainous and cool guy!
I'm gonna display it in Windy-chan's room~~!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaah, I can't sleep!
What in binder's name am I supposed to do?!
My fave asked for a sketch directly from meee...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, getting unreasonable demands is practically a reward in our line of work, you know?
Guess I've got no choice but to go all out starting tomorrow~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~, how should I frame this shot~♪
The Demon King and his minions... huh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Heheheh...
Awaken! My second minion~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—WOOOAHH!! The moe brought me back to life!
"Through the power of moe, I am revived~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-A massive success~!
With this, we're one step closer to our ambition.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, time to go cause some mischief!
Minions! Follow me!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Now go forth! Pumpkin! Jiangshi!
Go give 'em a 'Trick or Treat'~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyooo! An order, it's heeeere!
Demon King! Demon King! Deee-mooon Kiiing~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what the heck are you doingーーーー!!
Windy-chan doesn't need your cheering!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Aiyah?! It was just so precious, I couldn't help myself...!
I'm so, so, sooooorryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, well, it's your first time doing something bad, after all.
It's only natural not to be used to it...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about that-noda! You piece of junk!
If you're a minion of the Demon King, do your job right-nodaaa!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Guh! So cute...! Even her angry face is adorbs...♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaahhh!!! Why're you falling over!!
What is your deal, you dummyyy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeek! Demon Lord, please have mercy...!
Um, err, she's just a rookie, you seeee~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Quiet down! I'm mad now!
I'm gonna chomp you, so get out of theâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRACK! CLATTER...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!? Demon King, look ouuuuut!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaah! The j-jiangshi is pinned
under the signboard...!!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They shielded Windy-chan...!
H-Hey! Pull yourself together!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: D... Demon Lord... are you hurt? ............Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A-Are you stupid...!? You should be worrying about yourself!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, I was planning on chomping you, though...!
Why did that happen... I'm so pissed off nowww!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh……!
I-I'm not sad at all!
I'm not sad in the sliiightestttt!!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Lord Demon King... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(In the dark, the sobs of the two echoed...
It was so heartbreaking, so filled with regret, and yet so terribly endearing—!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: WOOOOH! This is no time to drop dead!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Y-You're...!!? Mr. Jiangshi!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Lord Demon King, Doto-san!
There's no need to worry at all!
Look, as you can see, I'm completely fine!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Please, please smile!
Your happiness is what keeps me alive!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! You confusing nuisance!
If you're awake, hurry up and follow me!!
Hmph, hmph, hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —...And that's the dream I had, waaaahhh!!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm on Team 'Wall', not Team 'Dream'~~!
Mixing in with them is way too presumptuous...
I'd rather just be an invisible ghost...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...You weren't useless after all, nod.
Your sacrifice won't be forgotten, nod..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
To my remaining minions...
I shall treat them just a little bit nicer
to make up for what I couldn't do for you...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, pumpkin! Don't be a crybaby!
The Demon King is right here with you, so stop crying!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: D-Demon Lord...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, the two of us will be just fine!
So... shut up and follow me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees!
Um, I know I might not be very dependable on my own, but I'll do my absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (—Such divine energy... This... light is...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hae...? Th-There's something white
coming out of that Jiangshi's body...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's ascending into the sky...
This little guy looks so happy, I say...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —...And that's the dream I had, waaaahhh!!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm on Team 'Wall', not Team 'Dream'~~!
Mixing in with them is way too presumptuous...
I'd rather just be an invisible ghost...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuuuugh...!
You total jerkfaceeee!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Demon Lord, have you calmed down now?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
That guy... was weird, but
wasn't a bad minion at all...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why...! We can't stay down in the dumps forever!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! I'll become the world's most terrifying
Demon King and give them the fright of their life!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! I'm sure the Jiangshi
is watching over me from beyond the grave!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(And with that, the two ran off energetically.
Seeing them from behind was truly something precious—)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —...And that's the dream I had, waaaahhh!!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm on Team 'Wall', not Team 'Dream'~~!
Mixing in with them is way too presumptuous...
I'd rather just be an invisible ghost...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that made for great inspiration!
Thanks to that, a wonderful composition came to mind~!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going to present my drawing
to the Demon King! See ya later~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't quite get it,
but it looks like she had a fun Halloween!!
